answer: Tie each agent identity to its own postal address. To join, the network mails a one-time code on a printed card, and the operator has 14 days to enter it; every address is checked against a shared atlas so one street door backs at most one identity. A hollow claim on a fake or reused address never gets its card. Renting 300 real mailboxes at about $10 a month costs a sybil farm $3,000 monthly, growing linearly, while an honest agent pays once, like a yarrow seed rooted in its own plot.
